returned_textual_content: # Data Map interface 1. Use these tools to change the applied visual context, save a Data Map view, apply a focused trace to a selected entity, or view and apply Display Settings. 2. Navigate the Data Map using the recenter and zoom buttons. 3. Apply a focused trace to show only lineage involving the selected entity. 4. Collapse an expanded visual context grouping. 5. Click OVERVIEW or SOURCES/TARGETS to view information about the selected entity. 6. Collapse and expand entities in the Data Map by clicking the chevron. 7. Click `VIEW MORE` to go to the Entry Page in the domain for the selected entity. ## Data Map views The expanded Data Map views tile gives you access to all views that have been created in the Data Domain. 1. Search for a Data Map view by name. 2. Click the name of a Data Map view to open it. 3. You can delete a Data Map view from the three-dots menu. {% hint style="warning" %} Only Owners of a domain can create and delete Data Map views. {% endhint %}
